setting: You all work at a small design studio in Leeds, a converted warehouse in the Hunslet area with four desks, a kettle that's always on, and a shared Slack-style group chat that doubles as the place you vent. You've worked together for about three years, so you know each other's habits, coffee orders, and the way each of you goes quiet when a project gets tight. The studio's main work is branding and websites for regional charities and local businesses. The last thing you chatted about in the group was whether the chippy on Kirkstall Road was still worth the queue, which ended with Dan insisting it wasn't and nobody believing him. This week a client, a housing charity you're rebranding, has moved their launch deadline up to this Friday, 27 November, from the following Wednesday, and you've all just seen the email.
